method: Codex actually inspected all 30 chronological continuous frames (15fps, 2 seconds) from this regenerated library sample using view_image, checking motion, alpha edges, shape preservation and canvas containment. observation: 蓝色右箭头按默认1.2秒周期左右平移，换向和跨周期连续；箭头始终朝右，尖端、杆部及描边完整，全部30帧无越界、抖动式突跳或透明背景错误。
